name: Troll brutes
advantages:
* Gives good experience when compared to the difficulty of killing them.
* Are weak to Air spells.
* Easily accessible in a cave north of the Burthorpe lodestone.
disadvantages: * Can be very boring and most of their drops are worthless.
notes:
These can be accessed in a cave north of the Burthorpe lodestone. 
These drops are generally not worth picking up, as picking them up will slow down kill times.

name: Zombie (Wilderness)
advantages:
* Weak to Fire Spells
* Easy to kill
* Have a low max hit
* Many located close together in the Wilderness just north-east of the Wilderness Crater lodestone.
* Aggressive
notes: Located in the Wilderness just north-east of the Wilderness Crater lodestone.

name: Crocodiles
advantages:
* Weak to Air Spells
* Low Defence
* Low max hit
disadvantages:
* No drops
* Found in the desert south-west of Pollnivneach, so any kind of heat protection is highly recommended
notes: Located in the desert south-west of Pollnivneach.

name: Fetid zombies
advantages:
* Weak to Air Spells
* Can be assigned as a slayer task from The Raptor
* Low Defence
* Permanently Aggressive
* Can be afked for >15 minutes as the player can not be forcefully logged out in the wilderness while in combat
disadvantages:
* Found in the wilderness north-west of Fort Forinthry
*Blood amulet of fury is highly recommended along with protect from melee and prayer restoration sources. Vampyrism gloves can also be used to provide some healing.

name: Ivar, King of Bones
drops: Unique drops such as bonecrusher maul, Magic skull mask and colossal bone
advantages:
* Provides 400 prayer xp each kill with colossal bone
* Weak to air spells
* Fast teleport with War's Retreat
* Introduces new boss mechanics
disadvantages:
*Requires food at lower defence levels
* Locked behind the short quest Visions of Havenhythe

name: Ogres
advantages:
* Very close to Yanille Lodestone and Castle Wars
* Weak to air spells
* Can be safe spotted
disadvantages: * Drops are uncommon and not valuable

name: Ankous
advantages:
* Can be safe spotted in their Stronghold of Security location
* Can increase experience rates by using salve amulet or salve amulet (e)
disadvantages:
* Far away from a bank
* Can hit hard on lower level players
drops: Coins, mystic cloth, lots of grimy herbs and herb seeds

name: Bloodvelds
advantages:
* Drops a decent amount of charms, and high-alchable items
* Drops some food to extend trips

name: Abyssal monsters
advantages:
* Monsters are aggressive and quickly surround the player 
* Ancient Magicks spells are extremely effective here
* Abilities like Corruption Blast and Chain can hit many mobs at once
* Very fast experience
* Extremely AFK
disadvantages: * Players need to purchase a Mazcab ability codex to unlock Corruption Blast

name: Exiled kalphites
advantages:
* Can be safe spotted at the bend of the path in the Exiled Kalphite Hive
* Drop a lot of Crimson charms and Blue charms
* Decent source of money
disadvantages: * Can hit hard on lower level players (if they are not safe spotting)
drops: Various alchable items, grimy herbs and herb seeds

name: Gargoyles
advantages:
* Very good source of money
* Located in the Slayer Tower, players can get a Slayer contract for some extra Slayer and Magic experience
disadvantages:
* Requires 75 Slayer to kill
* Very inefficient until the 'learn how to deliver killing blows quicker' ability is bought from a Slayer master
drops: Granite maul, Gems, many alchable items

name: Abyssal demons
advantages:
* Very good source of money and crimson charms
* Located in the Slayer Tower, players can get a Slayer contract for some extra Slayer and Magic experience
* Can be easily AFK-ed at higher levels with aggression potions
* Very fast experience
disadvantages:
* Requires 85 Slayer to kill and 71 Agility to access the preferred training spot
* Often crowded
drops: Abyssal whip, abyssal wand/orb (only while on a Slayer assignment), gems, many alchable items

name: Corrupted scorpions
advantages:
* Very good source of money and crimson charms
* Located in the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon
* Can be easily AFK-ed at higher levels with aggression potions
* Very fast experience
disadvantages:
* Requires 88 Slayer to kill
* Often crowded
* A Feather of Ma'at is consumed each kill
notes: Feather of Ma'at costing 1,500 coins or more on the GE is required for every kill
drops: Coins, Key to the Crossing, Vital sparks. Drops are auto-looted to the chest, except Keys to the Crossing.

name: Waterfiends
advantages:
* Good source of crimson charms
* Located in the Ancient Cavern very close to a Fairy ring
* High amount of experience per kill
disadvantages:
* Can often hit hard against players using magic
* High Defence
drops: Crimson charms, water orbs, raw sharks, raw lobsters, many alchable items

name: Muspahs
advantages:
* Ancient Magicks spells do double damage
* Aggressive to the player and spawn quickly
* Very good source of money
* Instanced, so no time is wasted looking for an open world
disadvantages:
* Requires Fate of the Gods to access
* Without Soul Split players may find it difficult to survive for long periods of time without banking
drops: Muspah spines, various dragon items and alchables

name: God Wars Dungeon Bosses (excluding Nex)
combat:
Generals
* K'ril Tsutsaroth - 650
* Kree'arra - 580
* Commander Zilyana - 596
* General Graardor - 624
advantages:
* Drops can be very valuable.
* At high levels, the bosses are able to be done entirely solo.
* Using an instance can create very fast kills (provided that the spawn setting is on fast/fastest).
disadvantages: * A killcount hampers exp gain, as it takes time between banking trips (unless the Totem of Intimidation or War's Blessing 2 are owned).
drops: Bandos equipment, robes of subjugation, Saradomin sword, Armadyl crossbow, off-hand Armadyl crossbow, many other assorted supplies and noted drops

name: Glacors
advantages:
* Very good source of crimson and blue charms
* Easily accessible with a fairy ring nearby
* Very high amount of experience per kill
disadvantages:
* Can be difficult to kill if inexperienced with the Glacor's mechanics
* High defence
* Requires Ritual of the Mahjarrat to access
drops: Pure essence, shards of Armadyl (for Armadyl battlestaff) glaiven boots, ragefire boots, and steadfast boots, lots of grimy herbs

name: Ganodermic beasts
advantages:
* Low max hit
* Easily accessible with a Fairy ring near the entrance to the Polypore Dungeon
* Often not very crowded
* Good source of money
drops: Ganodermic flake, ganodermic boots and gloves, tree seeds

name: The Magister
drops: Phylactery, Vital spark, Gloves of passage
advantages:
* Fast kills can result in a large amount of experience per hour.
* Potentially lucrative drops such as materials to create tier 92 khopeshes and ability codexes.
* Counts as a Soul devourer on task giving 8,000 Slayer experience, with Tuska's wrath dealing up to 15,000 damage making kills faster as well.
* For those with required Slayer level, with high combat, Herblore, and equipment, kills can give much higher experience hour than other methods, making it ideal for those going for high virtual levels.
disadvantages:
* Requires 1 Key to the Crossing for every kill which can be expensive, especially when coupled with non-valuable drops.
* Requires 115 Slayer to kill; this can be boosted, but must last for the whole fight.
* High intensity and many high level skills are required to achieve maximum experience rates (i.e. Overloads, Turmoil, etc).
notes: Magister is more effective for players training Magic beyond level 99
